description_en: Queries the details of a specified job
description_zh: 按照相关参数查询指定作业详情
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-jobs-with-filters --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListJobsWithFilters

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number to return.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The users that run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的用户列表信息
parameters.name: users

parameters.help_en: The information about the queues in which the job is run
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的队列列表信息
parameters.name: queues

parameters.help_en: The information about the computing nodes that are used to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的计算节点列表信息
parameters.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: The name of the job. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 作业名称。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

all
finished
notfinish

Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
作业状态。取值范围：

all：所有状态。

finished：已完成。

notfinish：未完成。

默认值：all
parameters.name: job_status

parameters.help_en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the execution time. Valid values:

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照作业执行时间进行排序。取值范围：

asc：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: execute_order

parameters.help_en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the time when they are submitted. Valid values:

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照作业提交时间进行排序。取值范围：

asc：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: submit_order

parameters.help_en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the time when they queue. Valid values:

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照作业排队时间进行排序。取值范围：

asc：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: pend_order

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html operation to query the list of regions where E-HPC is supported
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html查询可以使用E-HPC的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The earliest time when a job is submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 作业最早提交时间。格式为Unix时间戳，表示从1970-01-01T00:00:00Z起所经过的秒数
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: The latest time when a job is submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 作业最晚提交时间。格式为Unix时间戳，表示从1970-01-01T00:00:00Z起所经过的秒数
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable asynchronous query
parameters.name: async

ArrayRequest.description_en:
The job array. If the job is not in a queue, the output is empty.

Format: X-Y:Z. X is the minimum index value. Y is the maximum index value. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6
ArrayRequest.description_zh:
作业队列格式。如果不是队列作业，输出为空。

格式为X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业

LastModifyTime.description_en: The time when the job was last modified

NodeList.description_en: The list of compute nodes that were used to run the job
NodeList.description_zh: 运行作业的计算节点列表

Owner.description_en: The name of the user that ran the job

Priority.description_en: The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 处理作业的优先级。取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高

Queue.description_en: The number of queues that ran the job

Rerunable.description_en:
Indicates whether the job can be run again. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
Rerunable.description_zh:
作业是否支持重新运行。可能值：

true：支持。

false：不支持

Resources.description_en: The resources that were used to run the job

Cores.description_en: The number of CPUs that were used to run the job

Nodes.description_en: The number of nodes that were used to run the job

ShellPath.description_en: The path that was used to run the job

StartTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

State.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid value:

FINISHED: The job is completed.
RUNNING: The job is running.
QUEUED: The job is pending in a queue
State.description_zh:
作业状态。取值范围：

FINISHED：已完成。

RUNNING：运行中。

QUEUED：列队等待

Stderr.description_en: The output file path of stderr

Stdout.description_en: The output file path of stdout

SubmitTime.description_en: The time when the job was submitted

VariableList.description_en: The list of variables of the job

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的本页条数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
执行命令并获取结果的过程是否成功。取值范围：

true：成功。

false：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总条数
TotalCount.title_en: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
TotalCount.title_zh: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
